question_en: List the conclusions reached at the latest meeting, RAN1#121 (status of open issues).
original_query: MATCH (c:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumber: 'RAN1#121'}) RETURN c.resolutionId, c.content ORDER BY c.sequence, c.resolutionId LIMIT 15
reference_query: MATCH (c:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumber: 'RAN1#121'}) RETURN c.resolutionId, c.content ORDER BY c.sequence, c.resolutionId LIMIT 15
